source_id_policy: Each source_id binds to its exact_url, release_or_version, and locator below. New releases or changed page identities require a new source_id; do not silently rebind.

sources.title: GTFS Schedule Reference
sources.release_or_version: Official living reference; page states revised 2026-04-27. GTFS Schedule has no single protocol-version field on this page.
sources.locator: Term Definitions: Dataset and Service day; agency.txt: agency_timezone; trips.txt: trip_id and service_id; stop_times.txt: arrival_time/departure_time; calendar.txt; calendar_dates.txt; feed_info.txt.
sources.observed_operation: A dataset is a complete versioned set of files; service_id selects an operating-date set; calendar_dates adds/removes service by date; service-day may extend past 24:00; stop_times uses agency_timezone; feed_info may identify feed_version.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: calendar.txt is required unless all operating dates are specified in calendar_dates.txt; calendar_dates modifies the base service when used together; after-midnight times use values above 24:00:00 on the service day.
sources.applicability: Resolve the two terminals' trips, operating dates, extended times and timezone from the exact schedule release before display.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Reference
sources.release_or_version: Official living reference documents GTFS Realtime 2.0; change-history entries through June 2026. FeedHeader.gtfs_realtime_version is protocol version; optional feed_version is schedule version.
sources.locator: FeedMessage; FeedHeader; TripDescriptor; StopTimeUpdate and ScheduleRelationship NO_DATA; Alert active_period, communication_period, impact_period and informed_entity.
sources.observed_operation: Realtime entity identifiers resolve relative to an existing GTFS feed. FeedHeader includes a producer timestamp and optional schedule feed_version. NO_DATA conveys no realtime timing. Alert time ranges and entity selectors govern applicability.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Realtime version 2.0 is distinct from static schedule revision; feed_version is optional. NO_DATA must not be paired with a prediction time. Alert active_period may be absent; the alert then remains shown while present in the feed. June 2026 added optional communication/impact periods.
sources.applicability: Use as the primary protocol contract for version alignment, event conditions, and alert/time semantics; confirm which optional elements the regional partner actually supplies.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Trip Updates
sources.release_or_version: Official living GTFS Realtime 2.0 documentation; accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.locator: Trip Updates overview; TripDescriptor; Systems with repeated trip_ids; Alternative trip matching.
sources.observed_operation: TripUpdates carry stop-level time changes and may represent cancellation, added trips, unscheduled trips or rerouting; no TripUpdate for a scheduled trip means realtime is unavailable, not that it is on time.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Frequency-based/repeated trip IDs require trip_id, start_date and start_time; date can disambiguate long/late trips. route_id/direction_id/start_time/start_date is an alternative only if unique. The first-published start_time remains the trip-instance key when later time changes are carried by StopTimeUpdate.
sources.applicability: Map an update to one departure instance and display no ETA where the matching prediction is absent.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Service Alerts
sources.release_or_version: Official living GTFS Realtime 2.0 documentation; accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.observed_operation: Alerts report network/line/stop/trip disruption context, with active periods and selected GTFS entities. Individual trip delays and cancellations should usually use TripUpdates.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: If no active period is supplied, display while the alert remains in the feed; multiple ranges apply independently. Informed entities select affected services.
sources.applicability: Display disruptions within matched scope but do not transform alert text into per-trip status or time.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Best Practices
sources.locator: Feed Publishing & General Practices; FeedHeader recommendations.
sources.observed_operation: Recommends refresh at least every 30 seconds or when relevant content changes, TripUpdates/VehiclePositions data no older than 90 seconds, and Service Alerts no older than 10 minutes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: These are producer best-practice recommendations, not mandatory limits. Header timestamp may refresh when content is unchanged; consumers must still assess the age of data entities.
sources.applicability: Candidate freshness thresholds for pilot owner approval and stale-state design; not evidence that this partner meets them.

sources.title: GTFS Schedule vs GTFS Realtime
sources.release_or_version: MobilityData published recommendation page, living; accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.locator: Dataset change timelines; guidance to align identifiers/feed_version; short-term disruptions.
sources.observed_operation: Recommends matching identifiers and publishing feed_version in both Schedule and Realtime to bind a realtime feed to the schedule it describes. Describes schedule ingestion and Realtime alerts as distinct update channels.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Guidance, not a consumer enforcement rule. If a schedule update cannot be released at least seven days before service change, its recommendation is to communicate through Realtime instead.
sources.applicability: Supports schedule/realtime release handoff and publisher/partner version decisions.

sources.title: GTFS Realtime Full Revision History
sources.release_or_version: Official living revision history through June 2026; accessed 2026-10-10.
sources.locator: December 2024 FeedHeader.feed_version; May 2025 ADDED deprecation/NEW and REPLACEMENT; June 2026 communication_period and impact_period.
sources.observed_operation: Records dated spec changes for schedule version linkage, trip relationships, and alert time semantics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The added schedule feed_version remains optional per current reference. Current producers may use newer NEW/REPLACEMENT relationships; older feeds may use earlier forms.
sources.applicability: Pin parser and partner contract to the actual published realtime protocol/message support, not to old examples.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner GTFS GraphQL API
sources.release_or_version: OpenTripPlanner 2 current documentation; current release 2.10.0 dated 2026-09-09 on the linked current changelog.
sources.locator: API overview, endpoint and enablement configuration.
sources.observed_operation: Describes GTFS GraphQL as a general-purpose API used by Digitransit and otp-react-redux; a local endpoint serves queries; API is enabled by default.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Documentation is a moving latest page; deploy a named released build and verify its schema rather than pinning to this moving page.
sources.applicability: Credible alternate ingestion/API route, but the two-terminal display still needs its own UI and data-quality rules.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner GTFS-RT Configuration
sources.release_or_version: OpenTripPlanner 2 current documentation; current release 2.10.0 dated 2026-09-09 on the linked current changelog.
sources.locator: Alerts; TripUpdates via HTTP(S); MQTT TripUpdates.
sources.observed_operation: OTP configures Alert and TripUpdate updaters separately; HTTP updaters poll URLs, accept feedId, and have frequency defaults of PT1M; trip updater fuzzy matching defaults false.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Each updater requires a URL/feedId; frequency may be configured. Alert earlyStartSec defaults to zero. Exact defaults may change between OTP versions.
sources.applicability: If OTP is evaluated, pin release and configure the partner feed mapping/cadence intentionally.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner Changelog
sources.observed_operation: Release notes say OTP exposes GTFS feed version in its GTFS GraphQL API and fix long routes being grouped across service date.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The changelog lists merged release items; it does not establish quality on a particular operator feed or validate a deployment configuration.
sources.applicability: Current release candidate and an opportunity to observe/verify schedule-version metadata through the API.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner issue 6252: realtime update lag under load
sources.release_or_version: Issue reports OTP 2.7.0-SNAPSHOT; opened 2024-11-14; named data is National Rail GTFS plus GTFS-RT; no static feed_version/zip revision or commit supplied in issue body.
sources.locator: Expected/observed behavior; version; data sets; router-config.json; analysis of asynchronous graph update.
sources.observed_operation: Reporter observed realtime lag up to 20 minutes under load. Diagnosis: another poll could start before the prior graph update finished, accumulating older results.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Affects polling updaters when graph updates are slower than poll intervals; this report does not establish any static timetable revision.
sources.applicability: Relevant operational risk for middleware route; only the same operation under a named release and pilot load can be verified.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner PR 6262: make polling updaters wait for graph update finish
sources.release_or_version: Merged into dev-2.x on 2025-01-09; included in OTP 2.7.0 release changelog; 12 commits.
sources.locator: PR summary, fixes #6252, merged date, test statement.
sources.observed_operation: PR summary says all polling updaters wait for graph update completion before returning. The PR conversation's testing summary says no unit tests, while the changed-file list includes PollingGraphUpdaterTest; no performance/load test is documented.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Merged into dev-2.x on 2025-01-09 and included in OTP 2.7.0. Feature behavior is conditional on WaitForGraphUpdateInPollingUpdaters; inspect the released feature default and deployment override. The issue did not identify a timetable revision.
sources.applicability: All polling updater result application, irrespective of schedule version; no particular timetable feed version is named.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner 2.7.0 Changelog
sources.locator: 2.7.0 detailed changes; PR #6262 and car ferry functionality.
sources.observed_operation: Records the polling updater fix #6262 and car ferry functionality as items in release 2.7.0.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Changelog demonstrates release inclusion, but does not prove the fix for every workload or any specific ferry feed.
sources.applicability: Historical release tie for issue/fix chain; current candidate is newer 2.10.0.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner NeTEx & SIRI tutorial
sources.release_or_version: OpenTripPlanner 2 current documentation; current release 2.10.0 dated 2026-09-09.
sources.locator: Adding SIRI real-time data; SIRI-SX and SIRI-ET updater examples; graph build context.
sources.observed_operation: In the OTP implementation example, NeTEx carries schedule data; SIRI-ET provides expected journey times and SIRI-SX text situation alerts, configured separately as graph updaters. SIRI references NeTEx through Transmodel vocabulary.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Example uses Norwegian NeTEx/SIRI/OSM data and a specific Entur endpoint; it is not evidence of a ferry partner's availability or profile.
sources.applicability: Analogous schedule-plus-event/update mechanism, conditional on exact partner standards/profile and entity references.

sources.title: TransmodelEcosystem SIRI repository README
sources.release_or_version: SIRI schema branch v2.2, described by repository search result as latest branch matching CEN documentation and bug-fixes-only; repository says use releases for a schema matching a published CEN document.
sources.locator: Overview; supported SIRI services ET, SM, SX; branch table; repository release guidance.
sources.observed_operation: SIRI-ET conveys actual journey progress and expected arrivals/departures; SIRI-SX conveys perturbation situations. Repository contains schemas and examples.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: v2.2 is a stable schema branch; v2.3-wip and v3.0-wip are non-stable/development. National implementations may profile the standard.
sources.applicability: Pin any SIRI evaluation to a published schema release and the partner's national profile; do not assume generic compatibility.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner 2.10.0 OTPFeature source
sources.release_or_version: OpenTripPlanner exact release tag v2.10.0, released 2026-09-09.
sources.locator: OTPFeature enum entry WaitForGraphUpdateInPollingUpdaters and constructor; top-level otp-config feature configuration comment.
sources.observed_operation: The feature entry has defaultEnabled=true and sandbox=false; the enum constructor copies defaultEnabled into enabled. The source describes optional configuration under feature in otp-config.json.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: In this exact released version, waiting is on by default unless explicitly disabled by feature configuration.
sources.applicability: For OTP 2.10.0, version-pin and inspect deployed configuration; do not assume the flag remains on if config overrides it.

sources.release_or_version: OpenTripPlanner exact release tag v2.10.0, dated 2026-09-09.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: These are release contents, not proof of behavior on the ferry's concrete feed or deployment.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner PR 6262 polling graph update code
sources.release_or_version: PR #6262, merged into dev-2.x 2025-01-09; final listed merge commit 74241bd; included in OTP 2.7.0.
sources.locator: Files changed: OTPFeature.java and PollingGraphUpdater.java; updateGraph future result handling; PollingGraphUpdaterTest file.
sources.observed_operation: PollingGraphUpdater calls saveResultOnGraph.execute(task), then waits on the returned future when WaitForGraphUpdateInPollingUpdaters is enabled. Its code comments state that disabled mode returns after submitting the graph-update task.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The wait is controlled by the feature flag; OTPFeature source at v2.10.0 says enabled by default but config can override. The PR changes multiple pollers, including alert, SIRI, trip, vehicle position and parking updaters.
sources.applicability: Pin the OTP release and config; test the actual poll interval, update cost and schedule version for the pilot. This operational fix is independent of which timetable revision a feed represents.
